title: The Chinese edition is very close
summary: DHH says the installer is translated, downloads are served locally, and it has its own default theme.

topics.angle: What Alibaba Cloud’s $3 million pledge came with.
A menu without the AI tools China can’t use.

claims.text: The edition is getting very close; no date is given.
Alibaba Cloud will help with local CDN, hosting, website and meetups.
A merged change hides AI tools, apps and services that can’t be used in China.
The installer is fully translated, the edition has local CDNs, and Jade Horse is its default theme.
